title: 第5章 身份认可善良正直的岳父岳母第6章 十方气海获得鉴天录
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“呵呵，韩鑫，你终于说实话了！”
楚天铭冷冷一笑：“现在你还说是我偷袭你么？”
此话一出，众人纷纷明白过来。
原来并非是楚天铭偷袭，而是韩鑫先动的手！
不过明白了事实后，他们更是震惊万分。
楚天铭不仅挡下了韩鑫的攻击，还将韩鑫暴打了一顿，这家伙难道真的一直在装瞎不成？
“哼，韩鑫，你现在还有什么话说！
？”
韩正德脸色一沉，目光锐利的看向韩鑫。
“家主，我……我错了。”
韩鑫这才明白自己上了楚天铭的当，神色不由慌张起来。
“我们韩家的家风，讲的便是仁义正直，你竟然当众诬陷天铭，简直罪不可恕，来人将其杖责三百，罚俸一年！”
韩正德厉声呵斥。
“家主……家主我错了，请家主饶我一次！”
韩鑫吓得连忙跪在地上，向着韩正德磕头求饶。
“滚！”
然而韩正德一向讨厌别人欺骗自己，何况这家伙还是诬陷自己的女婿，他如何能忍，当即大袖一挥，一股强大的力量涌出，直接将其掀出了大殿。
“来人，杖责！
！”
“是！”

两个执法弟子立刻上前，将韩鑫托向殿外。
“爷爷，救我……”
韩鑫向着自己的爷爷连连求救，然而坐在椅子上的韩家二长老却是如坐针毡，根本不敢吭声。
毕竟韩鑫触犯了韩家的家规。
即便他身为韩家二长老，也无法多说什么。
啪啪！
很快，大殿外，便响起了一阵阵棒子与屁股亲密接触的声音，且伴随着哎呦哎呦的惨叫。
大厅内的众人，听的心惊肉跳，唏嘘不已。
打了整整半个时辰。
外面的声音才停了下来，而韩鑫也是没了动静，多半是晕死了过去。
“好了，这件事情到此为止，天铭这个女婿，乃是我韩正德亲自选的，从今以后，任何人也不许再有二话，谁若是再敢欺负他，别怪本家主不客气！”
content_en:
"Haha, Han Xin, you finally told the truth!"
Chu Tianming smiled coldly: "Are you still saying that I attacked you sneakily?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone understood.
It turns out that it was not Chu Tianming who made the sneak attack, but Han Xin who made the first move!
But after understanding the facts, they were even more shocked.
Chu Tianming not only blocked Han Xin's attack, but also beat Han Xin violently. Was this guy really pretending to be blind all this time?
"Hmph, Han Xin, what else do you have to say now!
? "
Han Zhengde's face darkened and he looked at Han Xin sharply.
"Master, I...I was wrong."
Only then did Han Xin realize that he had been tricked by Chu Tianming, and he couldn't help but panic.
"Our Han family's family tradition is all about benevolence, justice and integrity. You actually framed Tian Ming in public. This is an unforgivable crime. Someone will give him a three hundred rod and a year's salary!"
Han Zhengde scolded sharply.
"Master...Master, I was wrong, please forgive me once!"
Han Xin was so frightened that he quickly knelt on the ground, kowtowed to Han Zhengde and begged for mercy.
"Get out!"
However, Han Zhengde always hated others deceiving him, not to mention that this guy framed his own son-in-law. How could he bear it? He immediately waved his sleeves and a powerful force surged out, directly lifting him out of the hall.
"Come here, punish me with a stick!
! "
"Yes!"
Two law enforcement disciples immediately stepped forward and carried Han Xin out of the hall.
"Grandpa, save me..."
Han Xin repeatedly asked for help from his grandfather, but the second elder of the Han family sitting on the chair was on pins and needles and did not dare to say a word.
After all, Han Xin violated the Han family's family rules.
Even though he was the second elder of the Han family, he couldn't say much.
Bang bang!
Soon, outside the hall, there was a sound of close contact between the stick and the buttocks, accompanied by screams of ouch and ouch.
Everyone in the hall was shocked and sighed after hearing this.
The fight lasted for half an hour.
The sounds outside stopped, and Han Xin also made no movement. He probably fainted.
"Okay, this matter is over. I, Han Zhengde, personally selected Tian Ming as my son-in-law. From now on, no one is allowed to say anything. If anyone dares to bully him again, don't blame me for being rude!"
